projects.title: Gemini Hybrid UAV-UGV
projects.summary: A transformative hybrid vehicle system that seamlessly transitions between aerial and ground operations for enhanced mission versatility.
highlights: Developed unified control architecture for dual-mode operation
Implemented adaptive transition logic between flight and ground modes
Achieved 40% increase in mission endurance vs pure UAV configuration
projects.challenges: The primary challenge was maintaining stability during the transition phase. Solved through adaptive gain scheduling and real-time center-of-gravity compensation.
projects.improvements: Future iterations would incorporate terrain-aware path planning and predictive maintenance based on vibration analysis.

projects.title: GPS-Denied Rover Navigation
projects.summary: Autonomous ground vehicle capable of precise localization and navigation in GPS-denied environments using visual-inertial odometry.
highlights: Implemented visual-inertial odometry with <2% drift over 1km
Developed robust feature tracking for low-light conditions
Integrated LiDAR for obstacle avoidance and mapping
projects.challenges: Feature tracking failure in textureless environments was addressed through multi-sensor fusion with IMU and wheel odometry.
projects.improvements: Would add learned place recognition for large-scale loop closure and map reuse.

projects.title: HIL Test Rig
projects.summary: Comprehensive hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform for rapid autopilot validation and control algorithm testing.
highlights: Integrated sensor models for IMU, GPS, magnetometer, barometer
projects.challenges: Real-time synchronization between simulation and hardware required custom timing protocols and jitter compensation.
projects.improvements: Would add fault injection capabilities and automated regression testing pipeline.

projects.title: Wind-Aware Path Planner
projects.summary: Model predictive control-based trajectory planner that accounts for wind disturbances for fixed-wing UAVs.
highlights: Reduced energy consumption by 25% in windy conditions
Implemented real-time wind estimation from onboard sensors
Validated in 50+ flight tests with up to 15 m/s winds
projects.challenges: Computational constraints on embedded hardware required solver optimization and problem structure exploitation.
projects.improvements: Would incorporate learned wind field models and cooperative planning for multi-UAV scenarios.

projects.title: Rover Imitation Learning Stack
projects.summary: End-to-end learning framework for autonomous rover navigation trained from expert demonstrations.
highlights: Collected 50+ hours of expert driving data
Trained behavior cloning policy with 94% success rate
Deployed on embedded Jetson with 30Hz inference
projects.challenges: Distribution shift between training and deployment environments required data augmentation and domain randomization.
projects.improvements: Would add online adaptation and uncertainty-aware planning for safety-critical scenarios.

projects.title: Fault-Tolerant EKF for UAVs
projects.summary: Extended Kalman Filter with sensor fault detection and isolation for robust state estimation in UAVs.
highlights: Implemented residual-based fault detection with 95% accuracy
Designed sensor switching logic for graceful degradation
projects.challenges: Balancing detection sensitivity vs false alarm rate required statistical analysis and threshold tuning.
projects.improvements: Would add machine learning-based fault classification and predictive health monitoring.
